snippet.title: BRAVELY DEFAULT FLYING FAIRY HD Remaster | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
BRAVELY DEFAULT, the first title in the BRAVELY series is now available on Nintendo Switch 2, remastered in high definition! https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/bravely-default-flying-fairy-hd-remaster-switch-2/

Discover the origins of the innovative Brave and Default battle system alongside new and enhanced features , including all new mini-games!
